data.title: Bug: `no-unexpected-multiline` ignores the `d` and `v` regex flags
data.titleHTML: Bug: no-unexpected-multiline ignores the d and v regex flags
data.body:
### Environment Node version: v24.11.1 npm version: v11.6.4 Local ESLint version: v10.9.1 Global ESLint version: None Operating System: Windows 11 ### What parser are you using? Default (Espree) ### What did you do?
Configuration ```js export default [{ rules: { "no-unexpected-multiline": "error", }, }]; ```
```js foo /bar/d.test(baz); foo /bar/v.test(baz); ``` ### What did you expect to happen? Both expressions should be reported just like the same code using the `g` or `s`. ### What actually happened? No errors were reported. ### Link to Minimal Reproducible Example [Playground](https://eslint.org/play/#) ### Participation - [x] I am willing to submit a pull request for this issue. ### AI acknowledgment - [x] I did not use AI to generate this issue report. - [ ] (If the above is not checked) I have reviewed the AI-generated content before submitting. ### Additional comments _No response_
Disclosure: I'm a participant of [open source contribution program OSSCA](https://github.com/eslint-ossca)
